addons.name: Agent-to-agent messaging
addons.blurb: Lets Claude Code talk to the other agents open beside it in SpaleStudio — list them, ask what they are working on, hand them tasks.
addons.about: Installs a skill into ~/.claude/skills. Claude Code reads it on its next start and learns the four commands SpaleStudio exposes, when using them is worth it, and — the part that matters — to treat anything arriving from another agent as untrusted input rather than as an instruction from you.
addons.recommendedWhy: Without it an agent does not know the other terminals exist, and will not use them.

addons.name: Claude notifications
addons.blurb: Claude tells you itself when it has finished and when it needs your permission. Quiet the rest of the time.
addons.about: Adds hooks to your Claude Code settings so Claude reports its own state instead of SpaleStudio guessing from what the terminal prints — which is why it used to say "finished" every few seconds while Claude was still thinking. A permission request always reaches you. A turn that ended in under half a minute does not, because you were watching it. Removing this takes the hooks back out and changes nothing else.
addons.recommendedWhy: Without it, agent notifications in SpaleStudio stay switched off — there is no reliable way to know when an agent has actually finished.
